steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each deadline in the next thirty days is placed by its due date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 deadline within 30 days has no owner

findings.title: Deadline due within 30 days with no owner
Deadline with no source
findings.fix: Name the statute or contract it comes from

findings.title: Due date does not follow from its rule
findings.fix: Recompute the due date from the rule

outcome.notChecked: Deadlines not in the register; the current text of each law.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] notice-lease.md:12  Deadline due within 30 days with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner today.
[medium] statute-filing.md:19  Deadline with no source.
       Fix: Name the statute or contract it comes from.
[low] expiry-licence.md:26  Due date does not follow from its rule.
       Fix: Recompute the due date from the rule.
Not checked: Deadlines not in the register; the current text of each law.
pros: Checks a deadline due within 30 days with no owner, a deadline with no source, and a deadline whose due date does not follow from its rule.
cons: Not checked: Deadlines not in the register; the current text of each law.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-deadline-watch skill on the records for this review.
